ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web, containing organisms such as Grass, Grasshopper, Toad, Hognose Snake, Garter Snake, Hawk, etc. Toad is located in the middle-left part of the diagram, with arrows connected to it; among them, the arrow relationships show that snakes are consumers/predators connected with Toad, indicating that snakes will prey on toads. Reasoning: The question asks what would cause the number of Toads to increase. According to the rules of a food web, if predators decrease, the number of prey being eaten will decrease, therefore the number of prey will rise. Because snakes prey on Toads, fewer snakes will make Toads increase.
